c1.descriptionRaw:
After unleashing the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11500002}<color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling</color>{/LINK}, at the dance duet's end Odette will deal an additional instance of <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo AoE DMG</color> to nearby opponents that is considered:
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> or when not in a Radiance state: Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG at 300% of Odette's ATK;
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: Stellar Swirl reaction DMG at 450% of Odette's ATK.

Additionally, the Ascension Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is also enhanced: now, when the {LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK} is summoned, Odette also gains 2 stacks of {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK}. When Odette is off-field, the rate at which <color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color> is removed is sped up to 2 stacks per second.
c1.name: "On This Danceless Morn, She Gazes at Her Reflection"

c2.descriptionRaw:
The Ascension Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is enhanced as follows: every stack of {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK} active also increases the character's ATK by 7%.
Additionally, if Odette is in the {LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>{/LINK} state when there is a {LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK} on the field, opponents near the <color=#FFD780FF>Dance Double</color> will also have their corresponding Elemental RES lowered by 20%.
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> and <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color>.
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> and <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo</color>.
c2.name: "I Must See the Snow Swan's Unseen Dream for Myself, She Thought"

c3.descriptionRaw:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11502}Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers{/LINK}</color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
c3.name: "I'll Chase the Shouting Wind Along, Climbing Alone As I Go"

c4.descriptionRaw:
The Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Presto: Bluebird Finale</color> is enhanced as follows: when Odette obtains <color=#FFD780FF>Snow Swan's Dream</color>, Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by other nearby party members is increased by 50% of <color=#FFD780FF>Snow Swan Dream</color>'s effects.

Additionally, when a party member deals Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG to an opponent, Odette will also join in with a coordinated attack, dealing an instance of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>. This effect, which can trigger once every 3.5s, will be considered:
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> or when not in a Radiance state: Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG at 66% of Odette's ATK.
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: Stellar Swirl reaction DMG at 99% of Odette's ATK.
c4.name: "Up, Up the Long, Delirious, Burning Blue"

c5.descriptionRaw:
Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11505}Presto: Bluebird Finale{/LINK} </color> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
c5.name: "Oh! I Have Slipped the Surly Bonds of Earth"

c6.descriptionRaw:
The Ascension Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is enhanced as follows: When Odette grants {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK} to all nearby party members, her own Marvelous Splendor stacks will no longer decrease.
Additionally, characters affected by <color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color> have their Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt to opponents {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 25%, and Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by Odette is elevated by an additional 20%.
c6.name: "Put Out My Hand, and Touched the Face of the Divine"

profile.description: A famed Snezhnayan ballerina who blossoms against the frozen landscape with a beauty as sharp as frost.
profile.name: Odette
profile.title: Swirling Snow

combat1.descriptionRaw:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Unleashes a sword attack of up to 5 consecutive strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash a dazzling slash on opponents in front of her.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Attacks opponents in her path while plunging from mid-air, then deals AoE DMG upon landing.
combat1.name: Snow Swan Variation

labels: Coda at Dawn's Tolling Stellar-Conduct/Stellar Swirl DMG|{param3:P}/{param4:P}

combat2.descriptionRaw:
With slow, graceful dance steps, Odette deals <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> to the opponent, and also summons her {LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK} to the field.
If a <color=#FFD780FF>Dance Double</color> summoned by Odette is already on the field, this will re-summon the Dance Double and reset its duration.

<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>
Alternates between the <color=#FFD780FF>Plume</color> and <color=#FFD780FF>Wing</color> dance moves, periodically attacking nearby opponents and dealing to them <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>.
Additionally, for 6s after unleashing the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers</color>, Odette's Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers</color> will become the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11500002}<color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling</color>{/LINK}{LINK#N11500004}{/LINK} instead, where a dance duet deals <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> to nearby opponents over time. Then, when the duet ends, she deals another instance of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> that is considered Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl DMG.
combat2.name: Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers

labels: Snow Swan's Dream Stellar Glimmer Reaction DMG Bonus|{param3:F1P}

combat3.descriptionRaw:
With quick, lively dance steps, Odette deals multiple instances of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>, and summons her <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11500001}Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK}. She also gains <color=#FFD780FF>Snow Swan's Dream</color>, which increases the Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG Odette deals.
Additionally, for 6s after unleashing the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Presto: Bluebird Finale</color>, Odette's Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers</color> will be replaced with the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11500002}<color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling</color>{/LINK}{LINK#N11500004}{/LINK} instead.

If there is a Solo Dance Double summoned by Odette on the field, it will be summoned to her side with its duration refreshed.
combat3.name: Presto: Bluebird Finale

passive1.descriptionRaw: When Odette summons her {LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK}, she also obtains 4 stacks of {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK}.
passive1.name: Spring Rite of the Chosen One

passive2.descriptionRaw: For every 100 ATK Odette has over 1,000, her Stellar Glimmer DMG is additionally increased by 1.5% of the original DMG. She can deal up to 30% more additional DMG in this way.
passive2.name: Pathetique of Pateticheskaya

passive3.descriptionRaw:
Odette will enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state when she is inside a {LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>{/LINK}, or the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color> state for 8s after a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.
When a party member triggers a Superconduct or Cryo Swirl reaction, it becomes a Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl reaction instead, and the Base DMG of said reaction is also increased by 0.7% for every 100 points of Odette's ATK. A maximum increase of 14% can be obtained in this way.
passive3.name: Stellar Jubilee: Dance of Aurore

passive4.descriptionRaw:
Shows the locations of <color=#FFD780FF>Snezhnaya's Local Specialties</color> on the mini-map.
Practicing dance in one's spare time might even trigger other effects...
passive4.name: Echo of Winter Daydreams
